subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Which stable Feishu bot/account discriminator should become part of durable group session identity, and how should existing Feishu group session keys be migrated or repaired?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but changing persisted session keys crosses history, delivery, and bot-account authorization boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Account-Scoped Group Keys
options.body: Include the normalized OpenClaw Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

options.title: Platform Identity Keys
options.body: Use a proven Feishu app or bot platform identity if maintainers want durable keys to reflect Feishu app semantics rather than OpenClaw account ids.

options.title: Defer To Broader Identity Design
options.body: Keep this issue open while related Feishu multi-bot mention, context, and DM identity work converges on one shared model.

recommendation.title: Account-Scoped Group Keys
recommendation.body: Include the normalized OpenClaw Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent Feishu identity work and requested changes on the related multi-bot identity PR.
